Section 2 - Financial Information ## Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition. On October 22, 2026, Dow Inc. issued a press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference, announcing results for the third quarter of 2026. The information contained in this report, including Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of Section 18. Furthermore, the information contained in this report shall not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other document filed pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.
